articles.title: TIME IS HIS: Jungkook Commands the Cover in Harper’s BAZAAR Korea x Hublot
articles.description: 정국. Jungkook. Just the Name Is the Story There is a moment — quiet, almost imperceptible — that separates a global superstar from a cultural force. For Jeon Jungkook, that moment has long passed. What remains is something rarer: a man becoming the full version of himself in real time, and an entire generation holding their breath, watching. The feature highlights his development as an artist and public figure, characterized as "extraordinarily pure and instinctively different."
